children: Pendle has announced a Permissioned Markets Pilot, targeting whitelist-gated PT/YT markets for institutions and compliant users within two months, with launch partners currently in discussion. The pilot extends Pendle's real-world asset and institutional revenue lines by opening yield-trading markets to participants who require access controls.

Whitelist gating addresses a common barrier for institutions that cannot hold tokens in permissionless markets, since compliant entities often need verified counterparties and controlled access. If the pilot converts into sustained institutional volume, the added revenue would flow through Pendle's existing mechanism of open-market PENDLE buybacks, increasing token accrual for holders. The two-month target and partner discussions remain early-stage, so the pilot's scale and adoption are unproven until launch data arrives.

title: Pendle: Permissioned PT/YT Markets Pilot Targets Institutions Within Two Months - By 08 Nov 2026
